Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <3r407n$s...@esanews.denet.dk>,

Bo H. Pedersen <5...@dec5102.aarhues.dk> wrote:
>I was playing a jyhad game with some of my friends, and i had monnocle of
>clarity.... i asked "What will you answer on my next question ?"
>And they said i couldn't do that !!!
>
>Well can I ??

No. DTR 5/30/95: No questions about question nor answers. Any question
about the future is only binding until your (the controller of the bearer
of the monocle) next untap (so questions about questions wouldn't be binding
anyhow).

(You couldn't ask it in that form anyhow, since it is not a yes/no question;
you'd have to ask "Will you answer 'yes' to my next question?" - still
disallowed).
